title: The Green Hues
body:
A fresh, clean green-themed PvP texture pack designed for smooth gameplay, clear visuals, and a calm aesthetic that keeps you focused during intense fights.
Every element is carefully recolored and optimized to give your game a natural emerald vibe without sacrificing performance or visibility.

Resolution: 16x
